decisions.statement: A phone is named by the hardware udid its app's page states.
An app whose page names no phone is refused rather than guessed at.
The build runs on the single mac this workstation reaches over ssh.
The commit built is origin/main rather than the commit this checkout is at.
The native seam is synced before every build.
A build is installed only where its signature has the app's bundle id and team.
A build reporting no sentinel counts as nothing installed.
Each step the script got through echoes a mark of its own before the next runs.
A run that exited non-zero is answered with every step it got through named.
What the mac said is kept whether that run exited zero or not.
The run on the mac is handed in.
The keychain password unlocking the mac is handed in beside that run.
A caller handing the run in hands the password in too, so no secret is read.
Nothing here uploads to App Store Connect.

definition: one iOS app built on the mac and installed to a phone plugged into it
